verdict.rationale: Moneybird documents a first-party MCP channel on the same REST API, so an AI chat client such as Claude or ChatGPT can query live account data. That covers the core mechanism of an agent pulling data through the API. However, the pack never shows ledger, balance or financial-report data being exposed, or an agent answering affordability questions from it. Missing for 10: evidence of ledger/balance/report endpoints exposed via MCP or API, documentation of MCP tool scope, hands-on corroboration of grounded financial Q&A.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can ask an agent "can we afford X?" and get an answer grounded in live ledger data pulled through the API

citations.quote: Three channels on the same REST API: MCP for an AI chat, the CLI for the terminal, the API for your own software.
connect to Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or any MCP client.
